source_document.body:
Our midweek Green Deals edition is being led by Segway. The brand just expanded its EV Early Black Friday deal lineup for members, which includes the first discount on the 2026 MUXI Cargo Smart e-bike , while its Navimow Early Black Friday lineup has offers like the i215 LiDAR Robot Lawn Mower down at $1,399 , with other deals starting from $899. We also spotted a one-day-only chance to pick up Anker’s eufy SoloCam S340 Solar Security 4-Cam Kit with HomeBase 3 down at $580 (as well as an option to upgrade to 1TB of storage), the Aventon Aventure M Mid-Drive All-Terrain Smart e-bike with a foldable lock at $2,699 , some Worx deals on a 2-in-1 cordless chain/polesaw and the Cube portable vaccum, and more. There’s also the deals from the last two days at the bottom of the page below our best EV deals list, including yesterday’s exclusive Anker SOLIX Early Black Friday power station sale lineup , the Velotric Fold 1 Plus e-bike at a new $1,199 low, and others.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Anker launches 4K solar TrackLight Cam S1 with auto-tracking spotlight, alarm, family recognition, more
Segway offers MUXI cargo e-bike discount to $1,500 in expanded Early Black Friday Sale, more from $135
Alongside the three Segway Early Black Friday e-bike and e-scooter deals we spotted last week, the brand has expanded the lineup with member-only deals (sign-up is FREE) on a larger selection of models, including the first-ever discount hitting the 2026 MUXI Cargo e-bike down at $1,499.99 shipped , after membership. While it has been on the market since April, this newer cargo-focused model has kept to its $1,700 MSRP in the time since. With this sale, members can score the very first cash savings for $200 off the tag.
One of Segway’s newest commuting solutions, the MUXI e-bike is a cargo-hauling model with a compact design for everyday use, whether that is carrying around packages or groceries, dropping kids off at school, and the like. Equipped with a 750W direct-drive motor, its system comes powered by a 48V 717Wh battery in order to reach top 23 MPH speeds and carry you for up to 80 miles on each full charge. It can handle rider payloads of up to 235 pounds, while the rear rack has a 121-pound payload. It also boasts the brand’s usual array of smart features, including Apple Find My GPS tracking, proximity locking, a traction control system, and more.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Alongside some other notable standouts like the hill start assistance, kinetic energy recovery to recycle momentum lost to braking, and adaptive power algorithm, you’ll also find mechanical features like the hydraulic disc brakes, a single-speed drivetrain, a 600-lumen headlight, a taillight (with brake activation and turn signaling), a TFT display, and more.
You can browse the full lineup of Segway’s expanded Early Black Friday deals here .
Score Anker’s eufy SoloCam S340 solar security 4-cam kit + HomeBase 3 down at $580 (Reg. $900, Today only)
Running alongside Best Buy’s Early Black Friday deals , and as part of the Deals of the Day lineup , Anker is currently offering a one-day-only chance to score its eufy SoloCam S340 Solar Security 4-Cam Kit with HomeBase 3 down at $579.99 shipped , which beats out Amazon’s pricing by $70 . However, if you want bolstered storage over the base 16GB, you can find the same bundle directly with an extra 1TB of storage at $649.99 shipped , which would cost you $660 total adding the additional capacity ($80 value) to Best Buy’s bundle. Down from $1,080 at Best Buy, but it can be found at Amazon only going as high as $900, this daily deal’s price has only been beaten out in 2026 by drops to $550 that last occurred during June and October’s Prime Day events. You’re getting a $320 markdown off the going rate here for the second-lowest price of the year while it lasts until midnight.
You can learn all about what this Anker eufy security bundle does in our original deal coverage here .
Segway’s Navimow i215 LiDAR robot mower drops to $1,399 in Early Black Friday deals, more from $899
Right alongside the Segway EV Sale lineup , the brand has also launched its Early Black Friday Navimow deals on a selection of robot lawn mowers, complete with a “subscribe and spin” game that gifts you up to $500 in rewards. Among the spread, a top pick is the Navimow i215 LiDAR Robot Lawn Mower down at $1,399 shipped , which matches over at Amazon . Down from $1,599, you’re looking at a solid $200 markdown off the rate, giving you the second-lowest price we have tracked since hitting the market earlier in 2026. It’s only been beaten out once by a fall to $1,329 back during October’s Prime Day event. There’s also an option to bundle it with a Garage M accessory for $1,648.99 shipped (down from $1,849) that provides overhead protection for the robot when at its docking station, which matches at Amazon . Head below to see the full lineup of deals.
Segway Navimow early access Black Friday deals:
i206 AWD robot: $899 (Reg. $999) | not available on Amazon
i210 AWD robot: $1,099 (Reg. $1,299) | matched at Amazon
i215 LiDAR robot: $1,399 (Reg. $1,599) | matched at Amazon
i215 LiDAR robot with garage bundle: $1,649 (Reg. $1,849) | matched at Amazon
And more…
Aventon’s premium Aventure M mid-drive all-terrain e-bike gets a FREE foldable lock at $2,699 ($265 off), more
Aventon has expanded its Early Black Friday deals lineup with more models, so we’re shining a spotlight on the brand’s premium Aventure M Mid-Drive All-Terrain Smart e-bike with a FREE foldable lock ($65 value) down at $2,699 shipped . Normally $2,899 at full price, this model hasn’t gotten as many discounts in the year as its Aventure 3 counterpart e-bikes (currently $900 lower in price). Discounts in 2026 have mostly dropped things to $2,799, though there were some falls to this same rate, as well as a one-time fall to $2,649 back in July. The deal here gives you $200 cut from the tag ($265 total savings with bundle), for the second-best price we have tracked in its history on the market. You can see the full lineup of Aventon e-bike deals right here .
Make cuts below and above with this 2-in-1 20V 10-inch cordless chain/polesaw from Worx down at $130 (Reg. $170)
Amazon is currently offering the versatile Worx 20V 10-inch 2-in-1 Cordless Electric PowerShare Chain/Polesaw with 2.0Ah battery at $129.99 shipped . Down from $170, discounts have mostly kept this model between $140 and $133 in 2026, though things have fallen to this same rate in April and May, and dropped to $123 and $125 during June and October’s Prime Day events. The deal here cuts $40 off the tag for the next-best price of the year outside of those short-term Prime Day windows.
Tackle messes anywhere with Worx’s 3-pound 20V Cube cordless vacuum down at $59
